---
title: "Contact"
pagetitle: "Contact - Mathématiques en CPGE"
---

Vous pouvez m'écrire directement à : **mahari.cpge@gmail.com**

Ou utiliser le formulaire ci-dessous.

```{=html}
<form action="https://formsubmit.co/mahari.cpge@gmail.com" method="POST">
  <input type="hidden" name="_subject" value="Message depuis le site Maths CPGE">
  <input type="hidden" name="_captcha" value="false">
  <input type="hidden" name="_template" value="table">
  <input type="hidden" name="_next" value="https://maharicpge.github.io/merci.html">
  <input type="text" name="_honey" style="display:none">
  <div class="mb-3">
    <label class="form-label" for="nom">Nom</label>
    <input class="form-control" type="text" id="nom" name="Nom" required>
  </div>
  <div class="mb-3">
    <label class="form-label" for="email">Adresse e-mail</label>
    <input class="form-control" type="email" id="email" name="Email" required>
  </div>
  <div class="mb-3">
    <label class="form-label" for="filiere">Filière (facultatif)</label>
    <select class="form-select" id="filiere" name="Filiere">
      <option value="">—</option>
      <option>MPSI / MP</option>
      <option>PCSI / PSI</option>
      <option>TSI</option>
      <option>ECT</option>
      <option>ECS</option>
      <option>Autre</option>
    </select>
  </div>
  <div class="mb-3">
    <label class="form-label" for="message">Message</label>
    <textarea class="form-control" id="message" name="Message" rows="5" required></textarea>
  </div>
  <button class="btn btn-primary" type="submit">Envoyer</button>
</form>
```
